summary_md:
# Investmentbanken blåser småspararna

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-10-30  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Dagens Industri's Kort och Lång reviews the week's earnings, led by sharp criticism of Engcon's stalled European growth story and Fagerhult's failed acquisitions and rising leverage, plus Stora Enso's planned forest spin-off. The hosts then debate US hyperscaler reports, AI capex returns, financing risk and whether slower spending could be welcomed by the market, and criticise Anthropic's share structure and DNB Carnegie's lifting of the Upsales lock-up. The tone is cautious and halfway bearish, with the hosts split on next week's market: one long, one short.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ FAG — Fagerhult | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Host says the stock should absolutely not be bought now: weak market, poor acquisitions, debt nearing covenants, and earnings flattered by earn-out reversals.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion. Fagerhult's LED replacement case has faded, construction demand is weak and debt-funded acquisitions underperformed. EBITDA is falling, covenants are close within about two quarters, no dividend looks likely next year and a rights issue is possible, though Latour would likely resolve it and SEK 1bn in liquidity means no liquidity crisis. The apparent low P/E and 7-8% yield are backward-looking. Only a radical change would renew interest.

#### Sell Triggers

- Radical change in the business or strategy
- Banks and covenants resolved without a dilutive rights issue
- Sustained demand recovery

> *"Nej, det här ska man absolut inte köpa som det ser ut just nu."*

---

### 🔴 ENGCON-B — Engcon | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Host leans short: 27x earnings with no growth, organic orders -10%, Europe -20% and book-to-bill below 1 despite a 20% share price fall.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion. The growth story of 20-25% annually has delivered about 1% per year, and Q3 broke the improving order trend, with Europe, the intended growth source, down 20% and France collapsing. Analysts kept buy ratings while cutting estimates. The host wants to believe in a turnaround but finds 27x earnings offensive. Co-host notes the market wants to like quality names, so any growth or margin beat could revive the story. Founder-CEO candour was praised.

#### Sell Triggers

- Order intake turns positive in Europe
- Book-to-bill back above 1.0
- Margin beat revives the growth story
- Valuation falls substantially

> *"Så jag är nog snarare kort den här aktien."*

---

### ⛔ CRWV — CoreWeave | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Host called it a trashy company and urges caution on smaller AI winners. Debt trades at about 15%, undermining a capital-heavy model without existing cash flow.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion. CoreWeave fell 15% in one day after criticism on finance Twitter and has not recovered, surprising the host, who had expected a bottom. Average debt cost is 9-10%, but its loans now trade near 15%, so refinancing would be fatal for a model needing years of heavy investment before cash flow. Tighter financing favours hyperscalers with cash flow over neoclouds.

#### Sell Triggers

- Financing costs fall materially
- Debt refinanced on acceptable terms
- Cash flow arrives earlier than expected

> *"Man kanske ska vara försiktig med vissa av de mindre AI-vinnarna."*

---

### ⛔ UPSALE — Upsales | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Host does not understand the case: mediocre, competitive software, governance and sales-practice doubts, ex-CEO's full exit, and crowded retail ownership.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion. The former CEO promised to stay a long-term owner, then sold all remaining shares at a large discount during a lock-up waived by DNB Carnegie. Past press releases framed founder selling as institutions increasing holdings, and there were earlier questions about order reporting. The product is standardised with low barriers. Host sees risk equal to opportunity, with a crowded exit if retail flows reverse, though concedes the multiple could rise.

#### Sell Triggers

- Multiple re-rates on sustained profitable growth
- Improved governance and communication

> *"Jag är inte jättesugen på upsales som case"*

---

### 🟠 STE-R — Stora Enso | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host positive on the industrial assets but unsure how the forest will be valued; spin-off planned for end Q1 2027, co-host reads a cautious long. Capital markets day upcoming.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion. Overcapacity, lost Russian wood and cost pressure weigh on the forest sector, but consumer packaging is gaining share and assets are relatively good. The forest spin-off is a key event that will reveal the market price of the forest, which has never traded at book value. The host deferred a final view until the capital markets day; the co-host characterised it as cautious long positioning.

#### Sell Triggers

- Forest company prices well below expectations
- Spin-off delayed or cancelled
- European overcapacity worsens

> *"Jag är positiv till Stora Ensos skogsindustridel själva industriverksamheten."*

---

### 🟠 YUBICO — Yubico | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Up 25% in ten days on AI security theme. One host no longer keen after the rise; the other holds no strong view and says hype could double it, so hosts are not aligned.

#### Reasoning

Host opinions diverge. Robert was interested in spring but is not keen after the run, noting AI-driven security demand does not appear to be showing up and peer Fortinet fell 20% on its report. Michael finds it very hard to hold an opinion, saying the stock could double if concern over AI agents and hype persist, though it is not a case for him. Too speculative for a directional call.

#### Sell Triggers

- Report shows no AI-driven demand
- Cybersecurity hype fades
- Further peer report sell-offs

> *"Ett annat case som jag inte är jättesugen på är Yubico"*

---

### 🟠 GOOGL — Alphabet | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

After a 12-13% fall on softer search despite Cloud +103%, one host questions whether the market overreacted; hyperscalers said to have fallen a bit too much.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion, without an explicit buy call. Search still grew 12% and Cloud beat clearly; weak free cash flow was linked partly to a likely temporary EU fine. The market is extrapolating AI-winner risks and may be overreacting, though hosts understand why a core search miss prompts fear of AI replacing revenue over time. Treat as a possible overreaction to monitor.

#### Sell Triggers

- Search growth slows further
- Evidence AI models are displacing search revenue
- Free cash flow stays weak after the fine

> *"Men jag undrar om inte marknaden överdriver."*
